verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a keyed, metered API with a paid proxy option, so a spending cap or usage alert is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no budget cap, credit limit, or usage alert. The `x-max-tokens` header only trims the size of a single response, which is an adjacent control and not a spending cap.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set a spending cap or usage alert so proxy/credit consumption doesn't silently blow past my budget
